maya.chen: Hey team — quick ask. I'm seeing a 403 when opening the east-region model-health overview tile in the console. Anyone know if the grafana proxy changed recently?
ryan.patel: @maya.chen which link are you using? there are a couple of pinned tiles.
maya.chen: Using the workspace link from the runbook: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/model-health/east-overview (copied from docs). Click -> 403.
sasha.ivanov: That URL should redirect through our auth proxy. Can you paste the full browser URL after the redirect? sometimes the shortlink breaks if the embed token expired.
maya.chen: Full URL after redirect: https://proxy.internal.redwood/grafana/d/model-health/east-overview?orgId=5&panelId=2 — also seeing `Forbidden` in the browser console. No cookie set.
ryan.patel: Hmm. @infra-bot do we have any recent changes to the grafana auth role mapping?
infra-bot: auth-proxy: rollout v2.3.1 completed at 2026-02-14T18:12Z. No RBAC updates in that release.
ryan.patel: Okay, Maya — can you confirm 2 quick things: 1) you can access other grafana pages (e.g., https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/service-overview/), and 2) your account is in group `eng-platform-view`?
maya.chen: 1) service-overview opens fine. 2) I tried `id` in SSO console and I don't see eng-platform-view in my groups list. I thought I had it.
tony.ops: I can add you to the group now but want to check: do we limit access by region? eng-platform-view is global, model tiles additionally require `model-health-read` group.
sasha.ivanov: Yep — model-health tiles call a proxy route that checks `model-health-read`. If you're missing that you'll get a 403 even if you can view general dashboards.
ryan.patel: I can add `model-health-read` for Maya temporarily. @maya.chen will that unblock you for the current task?
maya.chen: Yes please, that would unblock me. I need to pull logs for a customer incident ASAP.
ony.ops: (typo) I meant tony.ops. Adding now... :hammer_and_wrench:
tony.ops: Done — added maya.chen to `model-health-read`. Cache may take ~30s. Can you try refresh with a hard reload (Ctrl+Shift+R)?
maya.chen: Refreshing... now it loads! The tile is visible and logs link works. Thanks. :tada:
ryan.patel: Great. Follow-up: Sasha, can you add a quick line in the runbook to note the extra group requirement? People keep assuming the pinned link is sufficient.
sasha.ivanov: On it — will add a note + a short troubleshooting snippet. Suggested snippet:
```
If you see 403 on model tiles: check group membership in SSO for `model-health-read` and `eng-platform-view`. If missing, request access via #people-ops or ping eng-platform on Slack.
```
ryan.patel: Also adding an observability ticket to adjust the grafana shortlink redirect to better surface missing-role errors (instead of generic 403).
ryan.patel: Ticket: INF-4382 (observability) — will reference it in the runbook entry.
maya.chen: Thanks all. One last thing — are there anyone who should be notified if this recurs? I'll add watchers to INF-4382.
tony.ops: Add @oncall and @eng-sre for now.
infra-bot: Created incident watcher group: observability-watchers. You can add it to the ticket.
maya.chen: Added watchers and updated ticket. Closing thread, thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
